title: Quantum Hive Fracture
description: A surreal scene shows a massive metallic machine embedded in cracked purple earth, its center revealing a glowing purple spiral vortex containing orbiting spheres. Above the fissure, a field of satellite dishes stretches to the horizon under a green sky, while multiple flying mechanical orbs with dragonfly wings hover in the air.
prompt: Surreal sci-fi landscape with a giant circular mechanical device cracked open in purple earth revealing an infinite glowing purple spiral vortex with floating spheres inside. A vast field of satellite dishes covers the cracked ground. Multiple spherical mechanical drones with dragonfly wings fly in formation against a swirling green sky. Detailed futuristic machinery, cosmic energy, dystopian atmosphere.
